recorded_at: cap-correction slice (Phase 8, clarification Q4) — basemap-inverted paint min flipped 1 -> 0.65 so out_srgb = 0.65*(1 - in_srgb); capped features never exceed 0.65. Visual smoke test approved by maintainer.
previous_record: inversion slice (e2dbb65): uncapped basemap-inverted (min 1 / max 0); features measured up to 0.72 linear, exceeding the cap clarification Q4 then set
method: Real-browser (headless Chromium, 1024x640 viewport) screenshots of the published bundle (dist/, served via nginx on :8090), slider driven via DOM 'input' event, buildings-fill hidden, central 50% crop with boundary-mask pixels excluded (linear luminance > 0.01). Luminance measured in sRGB byte space — the native color space of MapLibre's raster-brightness multiply — to match the shader contract.
pipeline_note: Differs from the previous raw-linear WebGL framebuffer pipeline (e2dbb65). The browser PNGs are sRGB-encoded by Chromium; measuring ratios and the cap in sRGB byte space gives the direct shader contract. def/max ratio is 0.6723 here (PASS within 5% of 0.65) and the cap is 0.6275 sRGB (PASS, comfortably below 0.65).

sc008_legibility.criterion: features-at-max (darkest p25 at max) brighter than background at minimum brightness
sc008_legibility.gate: PASS (streets/labels render lighter than the near-black inverted background)

sc008_cap_0_65.criterion: per-pixel sRGB feature luminance at minimum brightness <= 0.65 (clarification Q4)
sc008_cap_0_65.gate: PASS (0.6275 < 0.65, comfortably below the cap; no inverted feature exceeds 0.65)

fr019_grayscale.gate: PASS (inversion is exactly grayscale; no hue shift)

visual_smoke_test.approved_by: maintainer eyeball on the published bundle (slider 65 -> 5)
